reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni jiddiy cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta shart bor; ularga aniqlik kiritilmaguncha qatnashish tavsiya etilmaydi.

Lot hajmiga nomutanosib tajriba yoki resurs talabi (platformadagi mezonlar): Mezon 3 uchun 100 balldan 30 ball beriladi va talab: so'nggi 5 yilda kamida 3 ta shartnoma, har biri kamida 720 mln so'm (lot narxi 2,4 mlrd so'mning 30 foizi), jami kamida 2,16 mlrd so'm. O'tish bali 70 bo'lgani uchun bu ballsiz boshqa mezonlarda to'liq ball olish kerak bo'ladi, shuning uchun talab amalda majburiy bo'lib qolishi va kichikroq, lekin malakali loyiha tashkilotlarini chetlashi mumkin. Obyekt yirik (taxminiy qiymati 37 mlrd so'm), shuning uchun sabab bo'lishi mumkin; tekshirib ko'rish tavsiya etiladi.

Lot hajmiga nomutanosib moliyaviy talab (platformadagi mezonlar): Mezon 4 (15 ball) o'rtacha yillik aylanma kamida 5 mlrd so'm va o'z kapitali kamida 5 mlrd so'm talab qiladi; bu lot boshlang'ich narxi (2,4 mlrd so'm)dan taxminan 2,1 baravar ko'p. 60 kunlik loyihalash xizmati va 30 foiz avans sharoitida bunday moliyaviy ko'rsatkichlar kichik va o'rta loyiha tashkilotlarini ballsiz qoldirishi mumkin.

Bajarish qiyin bo'lgan muddat (5-bet): Ishchi loyiha texnik tekshiruv, gidrologik hisob-kitoblar, 4,5 km dan ortiq qirg'oq uchun smeta va kelishuvlarni o'z ichiga oladi, muddat esa 60 kun. Shuningdek, lot sarlavhasida muddat 60 oy deb ko'rsatilgan, hujjatda esa 60 kun; bu farqni aniqlashtirish kerak.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 42 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 2 ta; savdolarning 55% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 12%.
reasons_en: The document holds several conditions that may seriously limit competition; bidding is not advised until they are clarified.

Experience or resource demand out of proportion to the lot (platform criteria form): Criterion 3 carries 30 of 100 points and requires at least 3 contracts in the last 5 years, each of at least 720 million UZS (30 percent of the 2.4 billion UZS lot price, so at least 2.16 billion UZS in total). With a pass mark of 70, a bidder without it must score full marks on every other criterion, so the clause is effectively mandatory and may shut out smaller but capable design firms. The facility is large (about 37 billion UZS), so a reason is conceivable, but it is worth checking.

Financial demand out of proportion to the lot (platform criteria form): Criterion 4 (15 points) asks for average annual turnover of at least 5 billion UZS and net worth of at least 5 billion UZS, about 2.1 times the lot start price of 2.4 billion UZS. For a design service with a 60-day term and a 30 percent advance, this may leave small and mid-sized design firms without these 15 points.

Deadline that is hard to meet (page 5): The working design covers technical surveys, hydrological calculations, estimates and approvals for more than 4.5 km of riverbank, and the term is 60 days. The lot header shows the term as 60 months while the document says 60 days, which is worth clarifying.
In the customer's last 42 deals the median number of bidders was 2; 55% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 12%.
